framework.name: PCI-DSS v4.0 Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
framework.description: PCI Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0 provides a baseline of technical and operational requirements designed to protect payment account data. Mandatory for any entity that stores, processes, or transmits cardholder data (CHD) or sensitive authentication data (SAD).

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities for network security controls are documented and understood
controls.description: All roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 1 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.title: Network security controls (NSCs) are configured and maintained
controls.description: Configuration standards for NSCs are defined, implemented, and maintained.

controls.title: All services, protocols, and ports allowed are identified and approved
controls.description: All services, protocols, and ports allowed are identified, approved, and have a defined business need.

controls.title: Inbound traffic to the CDE is restricted to only necessary traffic
controls.description: Inbound traffic to the cardholder data environment (CDE) is restricted to that which is necessary, and all other traffic is specifically denied.
evidence_checklist: CDE Firewall Inbound Rule ACL Export

controls.title: Outbound traffic from the CDE is restricted to only necessary traffic
controls.description: Outbound traffic from the CDE is restricted to that which is necessary, and all other traffic is specifically denied.
evidence_checklist: CDE Firewall Outbound Rule ACL Export

controls.title: NSCs are implemented between trusted and untrusted networks
controls.description: NSCs are implemented between trusted and untrusted networks.

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities for secure configurations are documented and understood
controls.description: All roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 2 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.title: Configuration standards are developed and maintained for all system components
controls.description: Configuration standards are developed, implemented, and maintained to cover all system components, address all known security vulnerabilities, and be consistent with industry-accepted hardening standards.

controls.title: Vendor default accounts are managed and changed before production use
controls.description: Vendor default accounts are managed: removed if possible, password changed if account is needed.

controls.title: All unnecessary functionality is removed or disabled
controls.description: All unnecessary functionality is removed or disabled, including unnecessary software, functions, ports, protocols, services, web servers.

controls.title: All non-console administrative access is encrypted using strong cryptography
controls.description: All non-console administrative access is encrypted using strong cryptography including SSH, VPN, or TLS 1.2+.

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities for protecting stored account data are documented
controls.description: All roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 3 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.title: Account data storage is kept to a minimum with data retention and disposal policies
controls.description: Account data storage amount and retention time is limited to that required for business, legal, and/or regulatory purposes.

controls.title: SAD is not retained after authorization
controls.description: Sensitive Authentication Data (SAD) is not retained after authorization, even if encrypted.

controls.title: PAN is rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored
controls.description: PAN is rendered unreadable using strong cryptography, truncation, masking, or one-way hash functions.

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities for strong cryptography in transit are documented
controls.description: All roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 4 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.title: Strong cryptography is used during transmission of PAN over open public networks
controls.description: PAN is protected with strong cryptography during transmission over open, public networks. Only trusted keys and certificates are accepted.

controls.title: Inventory of trusted keys and certificates is maintained
controls.description: An inventory of the entity's trusted keys and certificates used to protect PAN during transmission is maintained.

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities for malicious software protection are documented
controls.description: All roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 5 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.title: Anti-malware solution is deployed on all system components
controls.description: An anti-malware solution is deployed on all system components, except those identified as not at risk.

controls.title: Anti-malware solution detects all known types of malware and removes or quarantines
controls.description: The deployed anti-malware solution detects all known types of malware, removes, blocks, or contains all known types of malware.

controls.title: Anti-malware solution is kept current via automatic updates
controls.description: The anti-malware solution is kept current via automatic updates.

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities for secure systems and software development are documented
controls.description: All roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 6 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.title: Software engineering techniques prevent or mitigate common vulnerabilities
controls.description: Software engineering techniques or other methods are defined and in use by software development personnel to prevent or mitigate common software attacks and related vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Security vulnerabilities are identified and managed
controls.description: Security vulnerabilities are identified and managed by installing applicable security patches/updates within defined timeframes.

controls.title: Critical and high security patches installed within defined timeframes
controls.description: All applicable critical and high security patches/updates are installed within one month of release.

controls.title: Public-facing web applications are protected against attacks
controls.description: For public-facing web applications, new threats and vulnerabilities are addressed on an ongoing basis and applications are protected against known attacks by deploying a WAF.

controls.title: Payment page scripts managed and monitored for integrity
controls.description: All payment page scripts that are loaded and executed in the consumer's browser are managed and authorized. A method is implemented to confirm script integrity.

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities for restricting access are documented
controls.description: All roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 7 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.title: Access control model is defined with need-to-know and least privilege
controls.description: An access control model is defined and includes granting access based on job classification and function (role-based access control).

controls.title: All application and system accounts are assigned and managed based on least privilege
controls.description: All application and system accounts and related access privileges are assigned and managed based on least privilege.

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities for identification and authentication are documented
controls.description: All roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 8 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.title: Idle sessions are timed out after no more than 15 minutes of inactivity
controls.description: If a session has been idle for more than 15 minutes, the user is required to re-authenticate.

controls.title: All user access to system components is authenticated with at least one authentication factor
controls.description: All user access to system components for users and administrators is authenticated via at least one of the following authentication factors: something you know, something you have, something you are.

controls.title: Account lockout after maximum of 10 failed authentication attempts
controls.description: Invalid authentication attempts are limited by locking out the user ID after not more than 10 attempts, or equivalent progressive delay.

controls.title: Password minimum length of 12 characters (PCI v4.0 Updated)
controls.description: If passwords/passphrases are used as an authentication factor, they meet a minimum length of 12 characters, containing both numeric and alphabetic characters.

controls.title: Passwords/passphrases are not the same as the previous four used
controls.description: If passwords/passphrases are used, they are set to a unique value for each user's first use and upon reset, and cannot be the same as the previous four passwords/passphrases used.

controls.title: MFA is implemented for all access into the CDE
controls.description: MFA is implemented for all access into the cardholder data environment (CDE).
evidence_checklist: MFA Enforcement Status for CDE Access

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities for physical access restrictions are documented
controls.description: All roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 9 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.title: Physical access to wireless access points, gateways, and networking devices is restricted
controls.description: Physical access to wireless access points, gateways, networking/communications hardware, and telecommunication lines within the facility is restricted.
evidence_checklist: Physical Access Log for Network Equipment Rooms

controls.title: Electronic media with cardholder data is destroyed when no longer needed
controls.description: Electronic media with cardholder data is destroyed when no longer needed for business or legal reasons.

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities for logging and monitoring are documented
controls.description: All roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 10 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.title: Audit logs are enabled and active for all system components and cardholder data
controls.description: Audit logs are enabled and active for all system components and cardholder data.

controls.title: Audit logs are protected from unauthorized modifications
controls.description: Audit logs are promptly backed up to a centralized log server or media that is difficult to alter.

controls.title: Audit logs are reviewed at least once daily
controls.description: Audit logs are reviewed at least once daily. Review includes: all security events, logs of all system components that store, process, or transmit CHD and/or SAD.

controls.title: Audit log history is retained for at least 12 months, with 3 months immediately available
controls.description: Retain audit log history for at least 12 months, with at least the most recent three months immediately available for analysis.

controls.title: System clocks and time are synchronized using time-synchronization technology
controls.description: System clocks and time are synchronized using time-synchronization technology. Time synchronization technology is configured to receive time from multiple designated time sources.

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities for security testing are documented
controls.description: All roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 11 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.title: Internal vulnerability scans are performed at least once every three months
controls.description: Internal vulnerability scans are performed at least once every three months. High-risk and critical vulnerabilities are resolved and rescans are performed.
evidence_checklist: Quarterly Internal Vuln Scan Report (<90 days)

controls.title: External vulnerability scans are performed at least quarterly by an ASV
controls.description: External vulnerability scans are performed at least once every three months by a PCI SSC Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV). Scans are performed after any significant change.
evidence_checklist: ASV Vendor Name and CVSS < 4.0 Attestation

controls.title: External and internal penetration testing is performed at least annually
controls.description: External and internal penetration testing is regularly performed and after any significant infrastructure or application change.

controls.title: Intrusion-detection and/or intrusion-prevention techniques are used to detect and alert
controls.description: Intrusion-detection and/or intrusion-prevention techniques are used to detect and/or prevent intrusions into the network.

controls.title: File integrity monitoring (FIM) is deployed on critical system files
controls.description: Mechanisms for change detection (e.g., file integrity monitoring tools) are deployed to detect unauthorized modification of critical system files, configuration files, or content files.

controls.title: Change/tamper detection on payment pages for HTTP headers and scripts
controls.description: A change- and tamper-detection mechanism is deployed to alert personnel to unauthorized modification of HTTP headers and the contents of payment pages as received by the consumer browser.
evidence_checklist: Payment Page Tamper Detection System Status

controls.title: An overall information security policy is established and published
controls.description: An overall information security policy is established, published, maintained, and disseminated to all relevant personnel and relevant third parties.

controls.title: A targeted risk analysis is performed for each PCI DSS requirement that provides flexibility
controls.description: Each PCI DSS requirement that provides flexibility for how frequently it is performed is supported by a targeted risk analysis (TRA).
evidence_checklist: Targeted Risk Analysis (TRA) Document per Control

controls.title: A formal security awareness program is implemented for all personnel
controls.description: A formal security awareness program is implemented to make all personnel aware of the entity's information security policy and procedures.

controls.title: A list of TPSPs with which account data is shared is maintained
controls.description: A list of all third-party service providers (TPSPs) with which account data is shared or that could affect the security of account data is maintained.
evidence_checklist: TPSP PCI-DSS Attestation of Compliance (AOC) Copies

controls.title: TPSPs' PCI DSS compliance status is monitored at least annually
controls.description: A program is implemented to monitor TPSPs' PCI DSS compliance status at least once every 12 months.

controls.title: TPSPs acknowledge in writing their responsibility for cardholder data security
controls.description: TPSPs acknowledge in writing to customers that they are responsible for the security of account data the TPSP possesses or otherwise stores, processes, or transmits on behalf of the customer.

controls.title: An incident response plan exists and is ready to be activated immediately
controls.description: An incident response plan exists and is ready to be activated in the event of a suspected or confirmed security incident.

controls.title: Incident response plan is tested at least annually
controls.description: The security incident response plan is reviewed and tested at least once every 12 months, including all elements listed in Requirement 12.10.1.
evidence_checklist: IR Plan Test Results and Lessons Learned
